metadata.question: Does Lake Urmia show a lower water redness in July 18 compared to April 23, 2016?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 TOA (COPERNICUS/S2) as primary, with windows ±3 days around 2016-04-23 and 2016-07-18; if empty, widen to ±10 days; if still empty, fallback to Landsat 8 SR (LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_SR) ±10 days. Region: Lake Urmia bounding polygon.
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds (S2: QA60 bits 10/11; L8 SR: pixel_qa bits 3/5). Create water mask using NDWI > 0 from cloud-masked image; compute mean red reflectance over water pixels.
3. Logic: If no images found -> C1. If 0 valid water pixels after masking -> C2. If mean red is null or outside [0,1] -> C3. Compare Jul18 mean red < Apr23 mean red -> A (Yes) else B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to evaluate ee.Objects
  const evalee = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate((r, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(r))));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const lakeUrmia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[44.5, 38.2], [45.9, 38.2], [45.9, 37.1], [44.5, 37.1], [44.5, 38.2]],
  ]);
  const targets = [
    { label: 'Apr23', date: '2016-04-23' },
    { label: 'Jul18', date: '2016-07-18' },
  ];

  // 2. Cloud masking and NDWI water mask
  function maskS2Clouds(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
    return img.updateMask(cloud.not());
  }
  function s2Prep(img) {
    img = maskS2Clouds(img);
    const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI');
    const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0);
    return img.updateMask(waterMask).select(['B4'], ['red']).toFloat();
  }
  function maskL8SR(img) {
    const qa = img.select('pixel_qa');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0);
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    return img.updateMask(cloud.not().and(shadow.not()));
  }
  function l8Prep(img) {
    img = maskL8SR(img);
    // Scale SR to reflectance
    img = img.select(['B3', 'B4', 'B5']).multiply(0.0001).rename(['B3', 'B4', 'B5']);
    const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B5']).rename('NDWI');
    const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0);
    return img.updateMask(waterMask).select(['B4'], ['red']).toFloat();
  }

  async function findBestImage(dateStr, region) {
    const date = ee.Date(dateStr);
    // Try Sentinel-2 ±3 days
    async function tryS2(windowDays) {
      const start = date.advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day');
      let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
        .sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
      const count = await evalee(col.size());
      if (count > 0) {
        const img = ee.Image(col.first());
        return { img, source: 'S2', window: windowDays, images: count };
      }
      return null;
    }
    // Try Landsat 8 SR ±10 days
    async function tryL8(windowDays) {
      const start = date.advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day');
      let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C01/T1_SR')
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .sort('CLOUD_COVER');
      const count = await evalee(col.size());
      if (count > 0) {
        const img = ee.Image(col.first());
        return { img, source: 'L8SR', window: windowDays, images: count };
      }
      return null;
    }

    let res = await tryS2(3);
    if (res) return res;
    res = await tryS2(10);
    if (res) return res;
    res = await tryL8(10);
    return res; // May be null
  }

  async function summarize(label, dateStr) {
    const found = await findBestImage(dateStr, lakeUrmia);
    if (!found) {
      console.log(`${label}: No images found in search (S2±3d/±10d, L8SR±10d).`);
      console.log('C1');
      return { terminated: true };
    }
    const { img, source, window, images } = found;
    let prepped;
    if (source === 'S2') {
      prepped = s2Prep(img);
    } else if (source === 'L8SR') {
      prepped = l8Prep(img);
    } else {
      console.log(`${label}: Unknown source.`);
      console.log('D');
      return { terminated: true };
    }

    // Reduce stats
    const redMean = prepped.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: lakeUrmia,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('red');

    const redCount = prepped.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: lakeUrmia,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('red');

    const usedDate = await evalee(img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    const cloudProp = source === 'S2' ? await evalee(img.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')) : await evalee(img.get('CLOUD_COVER'));
    const meanVal = await evalee(redMean);
    const countVal = await evalee(redCount);

    console.log(`${label}: Source=${source}, Window=±${window}d, Images=${images}, DateUsed=${usedDate}, Cloud%=${cloudProp !== null ? Number(cloudProp).toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);

    if (!countVal || countVal === 0) {
      console.log(`${label}: Valid water pixels after masking: 0`);
      console.log('C2');
      return { terminated: true };
    }
    if (meanVal === null || isNaN(meanVal) || meanVal < 0 || meanVal > 1) {
      console.log(`${label}: Mean red invalid: ${meanVal}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return { terminated: true };
    }

    console.log(`${label}: Water pixels=${countVal}, Mean red=${meanVal.toFixed(4)}`);
    return { terminated: false, mean: meanVal };
  }

  // Run for both dates
  const apr = await summarize('Apr23', '2016-04-23');
  if (apr.terminated) return;
  const jul = await summarize('Jul18', '2016-07-18');
  if (jul.terminated) return;

  // Decision
  const decision = jul.mean < apr.mean;
  console.log(`Decision: Jul18 < Apr23 ? ${decision}`);
  console.log(decision ? 'A' : 'B');
}

async function initEE() {
  try {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
    });
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
    });
    await runAnalysis();
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e.message || e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

initEE();
```
